Container.Name: EverShelf
Container.Overview:
EverShelf: Your pantry's best friend. A self-hosted, open source smart pantry manager with AI expiry tracking, barcode scanning, smart shopping lists, and Android Kiosk support.
Connects to OpenFoodFacts for product data (millions of items). Features include camera-based barcode reading, nutrition tracking, allergen information, and offline support for kitchen devices.
For full features (barcode scanning, expiry reading, AI recipe suggestions), you'll need to configure environment variables in the .env file: - GEMINI_API_KEY: Get free API key at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey for AI features - Optional TTS_URL/TTS_TOKEN for Home Assistant voice readout

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Port of the web interface (the container listens on 80).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: SQLite database, caches and logs — this is the pantry. Never put it on a tmpfs: an update would start empty.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Folder holding .env (created from the example on first start, writable by the app).

Config.Name: Configuration file
Config.Description: Where the app reads and writes .env inside the container.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for expiry dates, logs and cron.
